thread:
Noah (Partnerships): Quick sync - kicking off cloud marketplace onboarding for Pilot A. Need to confirm listing scope, billing contacts, and required legal artifacts.
Diego (Cloud Integrations): I can handle the vendor publisher roles and technical checks. What level of access does the publisher need for images/AMIs and billing metadata?
Priya (Product Marketing): We need two distinct listings: API-Metered (pay-as-you-go) and Reserved-Cluster (commit). Each needs separate short copy + feature bullets.
Noah (Partnerships): Agreed on two listings. Also partner requests explicit note about private deployment (VPC option) in the listing features.
Claire (Legal): For marketplace compliance: provide EULA, SOC overview blurb, and a minimal DPA. Also confirm if customer data will ever be logged outside customer-controlled regions.
Zoe (Marketing): I'll prepare screenshots and a 100-150 word blurb per SKU. Need high-res logo (SVG preferable) and a one-line tagline.
onboarding-bot: Action: marketplace intake form due in 72h - https://internal/redwood/marketplace-intake
Diego (Cloud Integrations): For roles: propose two IAM roles per cloud - publisher-admin (upload/listing) and publisher-billing-reader (billing metadata only). Sample Azure CLI to create role: az role definition create --role-definition @publisher-admin.json
Priya (Product Marketing): Can we standardize the SKU slugs? Suggest redwood_api_metered and redwood_dedicated_reserved. Keeps it consistent across stores.
Noah (Partnerships): Good call. Also list regions: AWS us-east-1, eu-west-1; GCP europe-west1, us-central1; Azure West Europe (confirm with partner).
Claire (Legal): Note: Azure has extra data residency checks. If partner insists on West Europe only, we must add a data residency clause. I can add a short rider.
Diego (Cloud Integrations): Technical ask: we should publish p95 latency and average tokens/sec for sample models. I can run a quick job against staging to gather numbers.
Zoe (Marketing): Tone check - avoid SLA-like claims. Use "designed for production" and list estimated latency ranges. Claire flagged this earlier.
Priya (Product Marketing): Also need to upload a usage example snippet for the listing docs: minimal curl example and node snippet. I can draft.
Noah (Partnerships): Partner asked about co-branded announcement timing. Can we plan an internal embargo until listing is approved?
Claire (Legal): Yes, provide draft co-announcement and logo usage license before any public mention. I need partner's trademark approval email on file.
Diego (Cloud Integrations): I'll prepare terraform + ARM templates for the publisher roles and a short README.
Noah (Partnerships): Recap action items:
- Diego: IAM roles templates + staging perf numbers (due +36h)
- Claire: EULA addendum + DPA rider for EU data residency (due +48h)
- Priya: SKU copy + usage snippets + sample screenshots (due +48h)
- Zoe: collect logos and prepare marketing assets + tagline (due +48h)
- Noah: submit intake, assemble listing checklist, confirm Azure region with partner (due +24h)
Zoe (Marketing): I'll drop assets into the shared drive and tag Priya.
Priya (Product Marketing): I'll mock the curl/node samples and attach to the intake.
Diego (Cloud Integrations): Starting role templates now, will ping when job finishes.
Claire (Legal): I'll DM partner for trademark confirmation.
Noah (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anything blocks please flag in this thread. :rocket:
